meta.description: Packages whose *published build* pins a CUDA runtime, regardless of what the project declares. Each entry maps a package version threshold to the CUDA runtime its binaries are built against, so the driver requirement becomes visible even when the project never mentions CUDA. Versions and CUDA numbers come from the upstream documentation linked in 'source'.
